Name: Mixed Seeds from Forage
Author: oxyk
Description:
Simple mod to make Mixed Seeds from forage. Uses everything in Forage category (green tag under name) to make 1-3 Mixed Seeds from 1 item.

Requires ProducerFrameworkMod

I made this mod to work with "Seeds are Rare" and ""Better Mixed Seeds" mods (playing game where shops don't sell seeds, have to find mixed seeds in the wild and then with Better mixed seeds planted seed can grow into crop of that season).

You can use this mod without other seed mods if you want to recycle your Forage into something useful.
